title: CAFE: Causally-Guided Automated Feature Engineering with Multi-Agent Reinforcement Learning
abstract: arXiv:2602.16435v2 Announce Type: replace  Abstract: Automated feature engineering (AFE) enables AI systems to autonomously construct high-utility representations from raw tabular data. However, existing AFE methods rely on statistical heuristics, yielding brittle features that fail under distribution shift. We introduce CAFE, a framework that reformulates AFE as a causally-guided sequential decision process, bridging causal discovery with reinforcement learning-driven feature construction. Phase I learns a sparse directed acyclic graph over features and the target to obtain soft causal priors, grouping features as direct, indirect, or other based on their causal influence with respect to the target. Phase II uses a cascading multi-agent deep Q-learning architecture to select causal groups and transformation operators, with hierarchical reward shaping and causal group-level exploration strategies that favor causally plausible transformations while controlling feature complexity. translated_title: CAFE：基于多智能体强化学习的因果引导自动化特征工程
translated_abstract: 自动化特征工程（AFE）使AI系统能够从原始表格数据中自主构建高效用的特征表示。然而，现有的AFE方法依赖统计启发式规则，所生成的特征在分布偏移下表现脆弱。我们提出CAFE，该框架将AFE重新表述为一个因果引导的序贯决策过程，将因果发现与强化学习驱动的特征构建相结合。第一阶段通过学习特征与目标变量之间的稀疏有向无环图来获得软因果先验，并根据特征对目标的因果影响将其划分为直接、间接或其他三类。第二阶段采用级联式多智能体深度Q学习架构来选择因果组和变换算子，通过分层奖励塑形和因果组级别的探索策略，在控制特征复杂度的同时优先采用因果上合理的变换。
tldr: CAFE将自动化特征工程建模为因果引导的序贯决策过程，利用因果先验分组特征并结合级联多智能体深度Q学习选择变换算子，从而生成在分布偏移下更稳健的特征。
en_tdlr: CAFE reformulates automated feature engineering as a causally-guided sequential decision process, combining causal discovery with cascading multi-agent deep Q-learning to select robust, causally-plausible features that withstand distribution shift.
